{"reason":"Change the medium/high branch action from suggest-alternative-supplier to alert-planner. v1 records 34 supplier switches at $45,000 each; alert-planner costs $35,000 and always arrives, saving $340,000 without worsening stockouts. This fixes failures such as medium/5.3 and medium/2.8, where supplier help caused stockouts.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
